items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Now Vicks went with Weidman and they sent for me to play the trumpet.

ctx.x: Well I think once I heard a rumor you played with the Wolverines for a while or something too, was that in New York?
Yes. Well I could never tell anybody this story because I never had the opportunity. Now Vicks went with Weidman and they sent for me to play the trumpet.
